definition: Tamara Ann Broderick is an American computer scientist at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology.
details: She works on machine learning and Bayesian inference.

explainer.lead: Tamara Broderick is an American computer scientist. Her work spans machine learning.

contributions.name: She led a three-day Masterclass on machine learning at University College London in June 2018.
She has developed a high-school level introduction to machine learning with the Women's Technology Program (WTP).

timeline.what: She attended Laurel School and graduated in 2003.
She studied mathematics at Princeton University, earning a bachelor's degree in 2007.
Broderick moved to the United Kingdom for her graduate studies, earning a Master of Advanced Studies for completing Part III of the Mathematical Tripos at the University of Cambridge in 2009.
Doctor of Philosophy, University of California, Berkeley
Named Fellow of the Institute of Mathematical Statistics
